integrity: Derivations and stand-alone exact-rational checks are supplied. Numerical/finite checks are not substituted for the analytical proof. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Single infinite population and symmetric two-action coordination game with payoff ratio u>1 and a-favoring sample ties.
Small-sample exclusion covers distributions supported on 1,2,3,4; explicit sufficiency only for 1<u<3/2 and support {2,5}.
Stable mixing is dynamical; it is not claimed to be a mixed Nash equilibrium of the underlying complete-information stage game.
No claim is made for other inference rules or finite-population stochastic fluctuations; bibliographic novelty remains subject to independent checking.
title: Five observations are the sharp cutoff for stable miscoordination under heterogeneous sampling
